verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS marketing platform that stores contact data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only email creation, sending, targeting, analytics and integrations; nothing documents retention policies, data deletion, or privacy-request handling. Excluding unengaged contacts from sends is an adjacent targeting control, not retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
